summary: Scout Watch on a container (GDD §05: a container's round time is learnable by Watch, in the mission only). New GameStashWatch.cs: WatchContainer checks the order: it refuses already-watched first, then too-far, measured with the existing rulebook sight.watch reach (R.SightReachCm) from the container's stand cell, then no-clear-line. It engages for R.SightWatchS at no cost. LandWatchContainer adds the container to the mission's learned rounds only on completion. HashStashWatch adds bytes only once something is learned, so historical hashes are preserved. Scout() routes container targets before the watcher path: other operatives still get only-scout, and doors or unknown ids still get target-unknown. Land dispatches the container watch. NextRound reports known from that state and stays a pure read. OnDone gives the activity text "learns when the round empties it". Cancel uses the existing watch line (lost, nothing learned). Hash.State calls HashStashWatch. Not yet verified: the clock, watch, replay and regression checks have not been run on this patch.
